# anm design system

> A design system for building products in Figma or in code, by hand or with AI agents, with a dedicated set for analytics dashboards. Package: @anm/design-system. Figma is the source of truth; each component below links to its full page (import, props, design notes).

The anm design system is for building products: by hand in Figma, by hand in code, or with **AI agents** prototyping in either. All three draw on the same components and tokens, and it includes a dedicated set for **analytics dashboards** (charts, tables, KPIs and dashboard layouts). This page is the short version of the rules, for designers, engineers and agents alike; every component's docs page adds its own **Design notes** from Figma (the "Why —" behind it).

Machine-readable index: [`/llms.txt`](./llms.txt) lists every component with its import and design notes in one plain-text file.

## Use what exists

- Search this Storybook before building anything. About 70 components cover forms, navigation, data display, charts, feedback and page patterns. The Templates show how they compose into whole pages.
- Never fork a component to change its look. Compose it, or pass `className` for layout only (width, margin, grid placement).
- If something is genuinely missing, build it from tokens and existing components, the same way the Product Patterns are built.

## Set up

```tsx
import '@anm/design-system/styles.css' // once, at the app root
import { Button, Stat, LineChart } from '@anm/design-system'
```

Two attributes on any ancestor switch the whole subtree:

- `data-theme`: `dark` (default), `light` or `high-contrast`. Every colour follows; high contrast also widens borders to 2px and the focus ring to 3px.
- `data-density`: `comfortable` (default) or `compact`. Control heights (28 / 32 / 40), table rows and container padding follow.

## Tokens, not values

- **Colour:** semantic classes only: `bg-surface-page | container | container-high`, `text-text-primary | secondary`, `border-border-subtle | default`, `bg-interactive-primary`. Never a hex value.
- **Status colour by role:** `bg-semantic-<status>` for a solid fill (Badge, dot); `bg-semantic-<status>-surface` with `text-semantic-<status>-foreground` for a tint (Banner, Tag); `text-text-<status>` for status text or an icon on a neutral surface.
- **Spacing:** token classes carry a `px` suffix: `p-16px`, `gap-8px`, `h-32px`. Bare `p-4` is Tailwind's own scale and is wrong here.
- **Type:** role classes: `text-display-2xl`, `text-headline-large`, `text-title-default`, `text-body-default`, `text-body-small`, `text-label-default`. Weight is separate (`font-medium`, `font-semibold`).
- **Focus:** `focus-visible:focus-ring`, the one focus treatment. Never `ring-*` or a border recolour.
- **Sizing that follows density:** `h-control-sm | md | lg`, `py-table-cell-y`, `p-container-sm | md`.

## Behaviour

- Hover, Focus and Disabled are real CSS states, not props. Only states with no native equivalent (Loading, Selected, Done) are props.
- One Primary Button per view. Secondary page actions are Icon Buttons.
- Touch targets are at least 48 × 48 (the controls extend their hit area on coarse pointers); pointer targets at least 24 × 24.
- Charts fill their container and redraw at its width; pass `width` only for a fixed size. Series keep their slot (colour and texture) across every chart. Use Small Multiples instead of a Line Chart with more than four crossing series.

## Copy

- Everything is in English. Numbers and dates are en-US: `1,284`, `12.5%`, `$128,450`, `May 27, 2026`. Format chart numbers with `formatChartNumber`.
- Sample data is generic business and analytics data: accounts (Account 4021), revenue categories (Sales, Subscriptions, Refunds, Commissions), USD, rates (Conversion, Retention, Churn). The placeholder person is Laura Romero (LR).

## Accessibility is checked, not assumed

Every story runs as a test in CI with axe. To pass:

- Every field has a name: a `FormField` label, a `<label htmlFor>`, or `aria-label` (Select, Slider, Multi-select).
- Charts announce their data through a generated `aria-label`; pass your own summary when the series are long.
- Text clears 4.5:1 in dark and light, and 7:1 in high contrast; controls and graphics clear 3:1.

## Where things are decided

- **Figma** ([anm Design System](https://www.figma.com/design/OSexn3GQ7oIOo7X2sGVlSb/anm-Design-System)) is the source of truth: tokens, component specs, and each page's **Code handoff** spec mapping Figma properties to React props.
- **Repository:** `tokens/figma-export.json` is the reviewed token pull; `src/tokens/*` is generated from it and never edited by hand.

## Components

### Core

- [AccordionItem](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/AccordionItem.md): Disclosure row for grouped content: a header (title + chevron) that reveals a body on expand. State=Collapsed/Expanded. Stack several with a shared bottom hairline for a list of sections — no separate container component, same relationship as Menu Item to Menu.
- [Avatar](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Avatar.md): User/entity representation with initials. Size for context; Status shows presence (Online/Offline).
- [Badge](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Badge.md): Small count or status indicator (e.g. notification counts), in solid semantic colors.
- [Button](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Button.md): Action trigger. Type sets emphasis (Primary > Secondary > Outline > Ghost); Size sets density; toggle Leading icon for an optional icon. Use one Primary per view. States: Default/Hover/Focus/Disabled/Loading.
- [ButtonGroup](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/ButtonGroup.md): Related Buttons and Icon Buttons joined into one control — Previous / Today / Next, a split Export button, zoom out / in.
- [Checkbox](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Checkbox.md): Multi-select or indeterminate choice within a group. Two axes: Value (Unchecked, Checked, Indeterminate) × State (Default, Hover, Focus, Disabled), so every combination exists, including Checked + Disabled and Checked + Focus.
- [ChoiceTile](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/ChoiceTile.md): Selectable tile for picking one option from a short set — a number, a category, a plan, a reason — where the answer must be hit fast with a gloved or wet thumb. Size MD 48 / LG 56 high; Align Center (numbers, chips) or Left (names). States: Default, Hover, Focus (the shared Focus ring, 2px wide, 2px outside), Disabled, Selected (solid interactive/primary fill) and Done (surface/highlight tint with a check and a Badge holding the count: this one already has a value) and Counted (the same tint and Badge without the check, 12px side padding). Properties: Label, Leading icon (swap). Set the count on the nested Badge (its Label property).
- [Combobox](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Combobox.md): Searchable single-value picker: type to filter, pick one. State=Default/Hover/Focus/Disabled/Error/Focus + Error mirrors Select's field exactly; State=Open shows the field with its filtered results panel, matching how Dropdown Menu documents its own open state.
- [Counter](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Counter.md): Large numeric entry for a small count: − / value / + with 64px buttons and a 36px value (Display XL). For a compact value inside a form row use Stepper; for free text use Input. State = Default, Focus, Disabled, Error. Value is a text property.
- [CountRow](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/CountRow.md): A row for entering a small count against one item: label on the left, a Stepper LG on the right. 64 high. State = Default, Filled. Filled adds a full-width surface/highlight band and a semibold label: this item already holds a value. Property: Label; set the value on the nested Stepper (its Value property).
- [DatePicker](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/DatePicker.md): Calendar for date selection, shown in a popover from a date input. Selected day = interactive/primary; today = ring; navigate months via chevrons. Use with disableFuture where future dates are invalid.
- [DateRangePicker](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/DateRangePicker.md): A trigger showing the active range and a panel with presets on the left and two months on the right. A preset applies at once; a custom range is two clicks (start, then end), with the days between tinted.
- [Divider](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Divider.md): 1px rule separating content. Orientation: Horizontal (spans width) or Vertical (spans height). Bound to border/subtle, the one decorative rule colour.
- [FileUpload](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/FileUpload.md): Dropzone for file input (XLSX import, image attach). Dashed border + upload icon + prompt + accepted-formats hint. States: Default / Dragging (border→interactive/primary) / Disabled. Shows uploaded files as rows below on success.
- [FormField](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/FormField.md): Standard form building block: label + control + helper/error. Compose with Input, Select, etc.
- [IconButton](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/IconButton.md): Icon-only button. Type (Primary / Secondary / Ghost) x Size (SM 32 / MD 36 / LG 48) x State (Default / Hover / Focus / Disabled). State mirrors Button exactly: Hover adds the 8% state layer in the icon colour, Focus adds the shared Focus ring, 2px wide and 2px outside, over the default fill, Disabled uses interactive/disabled with the icon on text/disabled. Swap the icon instance for any Lucide glyph; always give it an accessible label in code.
- [Input](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Input.md): Single-line text field. Wrap in a Form Field for label + helper/error. Supports a leading icon. States: Default/Hover/Focus/Disabled/Error/Focus + Error.
- [InputGroup](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/InputGroup.md): An Input with add-ons: fixed text before or after the value ("https://", "USD", "%"), an icon inside, or a small control at the end (a Kbd hint, a copy Icon Button).
- [Kbd](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Kbd.md): A keyboard key, shown inline in text, menus, tooltips and the Command Menu footer. In code, keys={['⌘','K']} renders a chord as keys side by side.
- [Link](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Link.md): Inline text link. State=Default/Hover/Focus/Visited; toggle External for an inline arrow suffix on links that leave the product. Underlined by default so the affordance does not depend on color alone.
- [ListRow](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/ListRow.md): Tappable row for choosing or opening one item from a list: leading icon box, title, optional subtitle, trailing chevron (a check when selected). 64 high. State = Default, Hover, Focus, Disabled, Selected (2px interactive/primary edge plus a check). Properties: Title, Subtitle, Show subtitle, Show icon, Icon (swap).
- [MultiSelect](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/MultiSelect.md): Multi-select / combobox — a select that holds multiple values as removable chips (Tag, dismissible) with a chevron affordance. Opens the same Menu panel as Dropdown Menu. For a single value use Select.
- [PinField](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/PinField.md): Four-box entry for a short numeric code, such as a 4-digit PIN: a label, four masked digit boxes and a helper or error line. 358 wide, boxes 56 high. State = Default, Focus (the next empty box takes the focus/ring), Error (all four boxes semantic/error) and Disabled; Filled = 0–4 shows how many digits are entered, each as a masked dot. Property: Label.
- [Radio](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Radio.md): Single choice within a mutually exclusive group — always use two or more together. Focus state uses the focus/ring token, matching Input/Button.
- [RadioGroup](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/RadioGroup.md): A legend + optional helper text over a stack of Radio options — the wrapper Form Field never generalized to. Form Field labels one control; this labels a set.
- [Rating](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Rating.md): A compact 3-tier scale indicator: three fixed segments (semantic/error, semantic/warning, semantic/success in order), the current tier at full opacity and the other two dimmed to 25%, with a label in the matching text token (text/error, text/warning, text/success), which stays readable in both themes. Severity=Critical/Moderate/Healthy. The labels shown are Critical, Moderate and Healthy, the same words as the property values.
- [ScrollArea](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/ScrollArea.md): A region that scrolls inside a fixed height or width — a long list, a chat history, a side panel — with a thin token-coloured scrollbar and a soft edge that says there is more.
- [Search](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Search.md): Search field with a leading magnifier, for filtering lists or global search.
- [SegmentedControl](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/SegmentedControl.md): Mutually exclusive view/scope switch (e.g. Day/Week/Month). Active marks which segment is selected. Active segment raised on surface/page + text/primary; inactive text/secondary on a surface/container-high track. Use for 2–4 options; use Tabs for page-level navigation.
- [Select](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Select.md): Dropdown to pick one option. Mirrors Input styling with a chevron affordance. States: Default/Hover/Focus/Disabled/Error/Focus + Error.
- [Skeleton](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Skeleton.md): Loading placeholder. Shape: Line (text row), Block (card/media), Circle (avatar). Filled with border/subtle; animate opacity 0.5↔1 in code for shimmer.
- [Slider](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Slider.md): Continuous value selector. Rail = interactive/default; filled portion + thumb = interactive/primary with a 2px surface ring. Pair with a value label or Stepper for precise entry.
- [Spinner](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Spinner.md): Indeterminate loading indicator. Size: SM 16 / MD 24 / LG 32. A 270° arc bound to interactive/primary; rotate 360° continuously in code. Use for in-progress actions; use Skeleton for content placeholders.
- [Stepper](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Stepper.md): Numeric stepper for small precise values (hours, counts). − / value / + segments in a bordered field; disable − at min and + at max. For free numeric entry use Input; for a range use Slider.
- [Switch](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Switch.md): Immediate on/off toggle for settings that apply instantly (no explicit save). Focus state uses the focus/ring token, matching Input/Button.
- [Tag](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Tag.md): Compact category or status label. Set Color by semantic meaning; enable Dismissible for removable filter chips.
- [Textarea](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Textarea.md): Multi-line text input for notes and longer entries. States: Default/Hover/Focus/Disabled/Error/Focus + Error. Atomic — pair with Form Field for label + helper.
- [ToggleGroup](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/ToggleGroup.md): A row of toggle buttons where one or several can be on — which series a chart shows, text formatting, view options.
- [Tooltip](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Tooltip.md): Brief helper text on hover/focus. Keep to a short phrase; never place essential-only info here.

### Data Display

- [AreaChart](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/AreaChart.md): Area chart — magnitude/volume over time. Fills at ~18% opacity with a 2px line on top (chart/series-N). Best for 1–2 non-overlapping series or a stacked total; for 3+ crossing series use Line Chart.
- [BarChart](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/BarChart.md): Data-viz primitive for comparing values across categories. Bars flex to the available width on a fixed 12px gap; a y-axis with gridlines gives the scale, and Show values prints each value above its bar.
- [Card](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Card.md): Generic surface for grouping related content.
- [ChartTooltip](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/ChartTooltip.md): Crosshair/hover readout for line & area charts. Header = x value; one row per series (color dot + label + value). surface/container-high + shadow-md; values wear text/primary, tabular.
- [DataTable](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/DataTable.md): A full analytics table: toolbar (search, faceted filters, Columns menu, actions), sortable and selectable rows, and a footer with the row count and Pagination. Built from Search, Faceted Filter, Button, Icon Button, Checkbox, Tag and Pagination instances.
- [DetailedLineChart](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/DetailedLineChart.md): Detailed line chart for analysis: several series plus the context that explains them. Target line (Target 0.80), optimal range band, forecast zone (dashed lines, open end markers, shaded and labelled Forecast), event markers (Campaign, Launch) and, in State=Hover, a crosshair that snaps to the nearest x with the series values in a Chart Tooltip. State=Default/Hover.
- [DonutChart](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/DonutChart.md): Donut chart: how one total splits into 2–6 parts (sample: revenue per account). A ring of arcs starting at 12 o’clock and running clockwise in chart/series-N order, a 2px gap between arcs, and a legend list on the right with each part’s value and its share. The centre carries the total and its unit and can be turned off with Center label.
- [FacetedFilter](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/FacetedFilter.md): A dashed trigger that opens a checklist of one column's values, each with its count. Once values are picked, the trigger shows them as chips (or "3 selected" past two).
- [GaugeChart](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/GaugeChart.md): One value against its range on a half-circle arc, with the value and its label in the middle and an optional target tick. For a single measure with a known ceiling — quota attainment, budget used, uptime — never to compare categories.
- [Heatmap](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Heatmap.md): A grid of rows × columns where each cell's tint shows its value — sessions by weekday and hour, conversion by channel and week. Hover a cell for its exact value in a Chart Tooltip.
- [HorizontalBarChart](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/HorizontalBarChart.md): Horizontal bars, one row per category: label, bar, exact value at the bar's end. For rankings and long category names (accounts, campaigns, pages).
- [Legend](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Legend.md): Series key for any multi-series chart. One swatch (chart/series-N) + label per series, in fixed slot order. Always present for ≥2 series; labels wear text/secondary, never the series color.
- [LineChart](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/LineChart.md): Line Chart — trend over time for 1–8 series (chart/series-N in fixed order). 2px lines, end markers with a 2px surface ring, recessive gridlines/axes, legend always present. Sample series are illustrative.
- [List](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/List.md): Vertical rows with icon, title/subtitle, and trailing content; dividers between rows.
- [ResizablePanels](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/ResizablePanels.md): Two or more panels side by side (or stacked) with a handle between each pair that drags to resize — a chart beside its table, a list beside its detail, an AI chat beside the canvas it works on.
- [SmallMultiples](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/SmallMultiples.md): Small Multiples — the same small area chart repeated once per category, in a grid, so shapes compare at a glance. Use it instead of a Line Chart with more than four crossing series.
- [Sparkline](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Sparkline.md): Compact inline trend line, e.g. within a Stat or table cell.
- [StackedBarChart](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/StackedBarChart.md): Stacked bar chart: how a total splits into parts across categories (sample: revenue per account, by week). Type=Absolute shows the bars on a 0–300 scale with the total above each bar (Show totals boolean); Type=Percent normalises every bar to 100 %. Series use chart/series-N in fixed order with series 1 at the bottom; segments are separated by a 1px gap in the card surface, the top segment has 2px rounded top corners, and bars are capped at 36px wide, centred in equal slots, like Bar Chart. The legend is always present.
- [Stat](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Stat.md): Single KPI: label, value, and a delta/trend indicator.
- [Table](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Table.md): Tabular data with a header row and data rows; status shown via Tags.

### Feedback & Overlays

- [Banner](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Banner.md): Inline contextual message tied to a region or page. Color by semantic meaning (Info/Success/Warning/Error).
- [BottomSheet](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/BottomSheet.md): Panel that rises from the bottom of a phone screen for one focused task — entering a count, picking from a short list — over a Scrim. Optional handle, a title with a one-line context, a swappable Content slot (Counter by default) and a two-button footer. 390 wide, top corners radius/xl, elevation/shadow-xl. Properties: Title, Context, Show handle, Content (swap).
- [CommandMenu](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/CommandMenu.md): The ⌘K palette: a search field over grouped commands and destinations, run from the keyboard. With an AI handler, the first row hands the typed text to an agent ("Ask AI").
- [Drawer](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Drawer.md): Side panel for secondary flows without leaving the current page.
- [HoverCard](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/HoverCard.md): A preview card that opens when a pointer rests on a trigger, or the trigger takes keyboard focus — an account, a person, a linked record, a metric's definition.
- [Modal](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Modal.md): Blocking dialog for focused tasks or confirmations; header, body, and footer actions.
- [Popover](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Popover.md): Contextual floating panel anchored to a trigger.
- [Progress](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Progress.md): Determinate progress bar for an ongoing task, with an optional value label.
- [Toast](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Toast.md): Transient, auto-dismissing notification (corner/bottom).

### Navigation

- [ActionBar](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/ActionBar.md): Pinned bottom bar for a phone screen: an optional summary line, one Primary Button LG and an optional Secondary. Properties: Summary (text), Show summary, Show secondary. Bottom padding of 32 clears the home indicator.
- [AppBar](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/AppBar.md): Top bar for a phone-width screen: menu button, Date Indicator (date and week tag) and Avatar, 56 high, on surface/container over a border/subtle hairline. Show date is a boolean property.
- [Breadcrumb](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Breadcrumb.md): Shows location in the hierarchy and enables upward navigation.
- [ContextMenu](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/ContextMenu.md): The menu opened by a right click (or the Menu key / Shift+F10) on an area — a table row, a chart, a canvas — at the point where it was opened.
- [DateIndicator](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/DateIndicator.md): A date with an optional context tag. Date is a text property; the tag is an optional slot controlled by Show tag. The sample copy shows a week label (WK 32) — illustrative content, not part of the component's contract. Retype or swap the tag for any short context label.
- [DropdownMenu](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/DropdownMenu.md): Menu opened from a trigger (button/field). Elevated surface with actions or options.
- [Menu](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Menu.md): Elevated list of actions or options. Compose from Menu Item.
- [MenuItem](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/MenuItem.md): A single row within a Menu — icon + label, with Default/Hover/Disabled states.
- [Navbar](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Navbar.md): Top application bar: brand/logo, primary nav links, and actions (search, avatar).
- [Pagination](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Pagination.md): Navigate paged data sets; the active page is filled.
- [Sidebar](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Sidebar.md): Primary side navigation: the workspace name at top, as text (no logo), nav items, and a user-menu profile at the bottom.
- [Tab](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Tab.md): Switch between peer views in the same context. The active tab shows the primary underline indicator.
- [Topbar](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Topbar.md): Alternate top bar: breadcrumbs (left), Date Indicator (center), and actions incl. search + alerts (right).

### Product Patterns

- [BenchmarkTable](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/BenchmarkTable.md): Productivity benchmark table — per-account rate (Revenue/month) with a tier-colored Status chip (Critical/Moderate/Healthy vs the 400 min / 800 ideal benchmarks). Table + Tag; numeric column right-aligned.
- [ContentPanel](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/ContentPanel.md): Titled surface that frames a graph, table, or content block: header (title + optional controls) over a content area. The graph/table sits inside borderless; the panel owns the card chrome. Primary dashboard container for the product.
- [EmptyState](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/EmptyState.md): A whole page or panel with nothing in it yet — icon badge, heading, one line of guidance, one primary action. Distinct from Card/Stat/List/Table's own built-in Empty state, which fills only that one component’s bounds; this is the bigger version, for a page or section that has never had data at all. It has no border of its own and fills whatever space it is given, like Divider and Spinner.
- [MetricCard](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/MetricCard.md): Dashboard KPI card — title + context, a hero value with unit, and a category tag. Product surface built on Card + Tag; use Stat for a compact label/value/delta tile instead.
- [PageHeader](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/PageHeader.md): Page/section header — title + subtitle on the left, actions (Icon Button + primary Button) on the right, over a bottom hairline. Add a Breadcrumb above for nested pages. Built from Button + Icon Button.
- [TableToolbar](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/TableToolbar.md): Search + active filter chips on the left, a secondary icon action and one primary action on the right — the header row that sits above Table or Benchmark Table.
- [Timeline](https://aangnm.github.io/anm-design-system/components/Timeline.md): An ordered event history per account — payments, reconciliations, transfers — a colored marker per event type joined by a connecting line, with a relative timestamp and one line of detail per entry. Event colors reuse the semantic palette already established by Benchmark Table’s tier chips (success/info/warning), not a new marker palette.
